node: Data-center power, grid interconnection, electrical equipment, and thermal infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expansion identifies one high-attention reference leader and three less-obvious US-listed suppliers/contractors with direct exposure to AI data-center power and cooling constraints. The strongest near-node exposures in this pass are medium-voltage switchgear and electrical distribution equipment, mission-critical cooling equipment, and electrical/technology systems installation for data centers. Market-cap discovery is harder than the original USD 500M-10B target because several formerly niche names have re-rated above USD 10B; they remain included where exposure appears unusually direct.
